PR1_hard_block.description: Quest cannot start without meeting this

PR2_soft_block.description: Quest visible but not startable; hints provided

PR3_recommended.description: Quest startable but harder without this

PR4_parallel.description: Quest requires another quest to be active

RW6_asset.description: Inventory item, memory, or AVN unlock

qst_svara_mastery.name: Svara's Calibration Mastery
qst_svara_mastery.description: Svara seeks to master micro-tonal calibration by tuning seven different ritual instruments
qst_svara_mastery.narrative_hook: The Princess has asked Svara to prepare the acoustic space for an upcoming abhisheka

qst_padma_service.name: Padmā's Devotional Cycle
qst_padma_service.description: Padmā undertakes a cycle of seven service tasks to prove her devotion to the Princess
qst_padma_service.narrative_hook: The Princess wishes to see if Padmā is ready for higher ritual responsibilities

qst_roxana_restraint.name: Roxana's Restraint Mastery
qst_roxana_restraint.description: Roxana seeks to complete seven complex suspension configurations
qst_roxana_restraint.narrative_hook: The Vizier wishes to demonstrate her mastery before an audience of peers

qst_jahzara_threshold.name: Jahzara's Threshold Vigil
qst_jahzara_threshold.description: Jahzara undertakes an extended vigil to prove her vigilance
qst_jahzara_threshold.narrative_hook: Suspicious activity has been noted at the palace perimeter

stages.name: First Watch
stages.objective: Guard the outer threshold for one full scene

stages.name: Second Watch
stages.objective: Guard the inner threshold for two scenes

stages.name: Third Watch
stages.objective: Guard the Princess's door for three scenes

qst_throne_loyalty.name: Throne Loyalty Audit
qst_throne_loyalty.description: The Throne requires a demonstration of loyalty from all court members
qst_throne_loyalty.narrative_hook: Rumors of dissent have reached the Sovereign's ears

stages.name: Public Oath
stages.objective: All characters renew their oath publicly

stages.name: Trial
stages.objective: Each character undertakes a loyalty trial

stages.name: Acceptance
stages.objective: Mahā Deva formally accepts or rejects each

qst_zenana_purification.name: Zenana Purification Rite
qst_zenana_purification.description: The Zenana undertakes a ritual purification to cleanse the palace
qst_zenana_purification.narrative_hook: An ill omen has been seen in the palace gardens

qst_military_drill.name: Perimeter Military Drill
qst_military_drill.description: The military undertakes a full perimeter defense drill
qst_military_drill.narrative_hook: The Sovereign has ordered a readiness assessment

qst_kala_wheel.name: The Kala Wheel
qst_kala_wheel.description: Undertake a wheel of all 64 Kalas to demonstrate broad competence
qst_kala_wheel.narrative_hook: A royal challenge has been issued for all court artists

stages.name: Domain 1
stages.objective: Attempt one Kala from each of the 6 domains

stages.name: Domain 2
stages.objective: Advance one Kala per domain by 1 stage

stages.name: Domain 3
stages.objective: Reach mastery 5 in any single Kala

qst_kala_synergy.name: Awaken a Kala Synergy
qst_kala_synergy.description: Combine multiple Kalas to awaken a synergy
qst_kala_synergy.narrative_hook: Whispers speak of forgotten combinations of ancient arts

qst_kala_teaching.name: Teach a Kala
qst_kala_teaching.description: Teach a Kala you have mastered to another character
qst_kala_teaching.narrative_hook: The court is in need of new teachers for its ancient arts

qst_kala_combination.name: Discover a Kala Combination
qst_kala_combination.description: Discover a new emergent Kala combination
qst_kala_combination.narrative_hook: The archive mentions lost combinations never formalized

stages.name: Registration
stages.objective: Register the combination in the archive

qst_navaratri.name: Navaratri Court Ritual
qst_navaratri.description: Undertake the nine-night ritual in honor of the Goddess
qst_navaratri.narrative_hook: The nine-night festival approaches, and the court must prepare

qst_amavasya.name: Amavasya Night Vigil
qst_amavasya.narrative_hook: The new moon approaches, and the vault must be prepared

qst_purnima.name: Purnima Celebration
qst_purnima.description: Undertake the full-moon ritual of renewal
qst_purnima.narrative_hook: The full moon rises tonight, and the court must celebrate

qst_court_alliance.name: Court Alliance Formation
qst_court_alliance.description: Form a political alliance between factions
qst_court_alliance.narrative_hook: Factional tensions have reached a critical point

qst_protocol_breach.name: Investigate a Protocol Breach
qst_protocol_breach.narrative_hook: A breach has been discovered, and the court demands answers

qst_reputation_repair.name: Reputation Repair
qst_reputation_repair.description: Repair damaged reputation with an institution
qst_reputation_repair.narrative_hook: Your standing has fallen, and you must regain it

qst_cipher_recovery.name: Recover the Lost Cipher
qst_cipher_recovery.description: Recover a lost cipher hidden in the archive
qst_cipher_recovery.narrative_hook: An ancient cipher has been reported missing from the archive

qst_secret_reveal.name: Reveal a Court Secret
qst_secret_reveal.description: Uncover and reveal a secret held by another character
qst_secret_reveal.narrative_hook: Whispers suggest someone holds a dangerous secret

qst_memory_recovery.name: Recover a Lost Memory
qst_memory_recovery.description: Recover a lost or suppressed memory
qst_memory_recovery.narrative_hook: A dream fragment hints at forgotten events

qst_trust_building.name: Build Trust
qst_trust_building.description: Build trust with a target character
qst_trust_building.narrative_hook: A bond has not yet formed, and must be cultivated

qst_relationship_repair.name: Repair a Relationship
qst_relationship_repair.description: Repair a relationship damaged by past events
qst_relationship_repair.narrative_hook: A rift has formed that must be healed

qst_intimacy_arc.name: Intimacy Arc
qst_intimacy_arc.description: Deepen intimacy with a specific character
qst_intimacy_arc.narrative_hook: The bond is ready to deepen to a new level

qst_chronicle_entry.name: Record a Chronicle Entry
qst_chronicle_entry.description: Add a significant event to the palace chronicle
qst_chronicle_entry.narrative_hook: A significant event has occurred and must be recorded

qst_legacy_recovery.name: Recover a Legacy Record
qst_legacy_recovery.description: Recover a legacy record from the archive
qst_legacy_recovery.narrative_hook: A legacy record has been discovered in the deep archive

qst_uncharted_location.name: Explore an Uncharted Location
qst_uncharted_location.description: Explore and map a new location in the palace
qst_uncharted_location.narrative_hook: A sealed door has been discovered in the palace

qst_sacred_object.name: Retrieve a Sacred Object
qst_sacred_object.narrative_hook: A sacred object has been lost and must be found
